name: ai-know
description: Look up plain-language definitions of AI concepts, curated AI tools by category, and a daily AI news digest from ai-know.org — a free, static, bilingual (English/Hebrew) knowledge base. Read-only: unauthenticated HTTP GET, no API key, no rate limits.

skills.name: ai-know-lookup
skills.description: Look up an AI concept or tool on ai-know.org and cite it: which markdown twin, feed or index to fetch, and how the content is structured.
